chunks: Abu Ali Muhammad ibn Hammam narrated to me, saying: Ja'far ibn Muhammad ibn Malik al-Fazari narrated to me, saying: Ahmad ibn Ali ibn Ubayd al-Ju'fi narrated to me, saying: Husayn ibn Sulayman narrated from Husayn ibn Asad, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Hariz, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him).
Whoever visits Husayn on the Day of 'Ashura, Paradise becomes mandatory for him.
ai.seo_question: What is the reward for visiting Imam Husayn on the Day of 'Ashura?
ai.summary: Recorded in Ibn Qulawayh’s *Kamil al-Ziyarat*, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (a.s.) establishes the Day of 'Ashura as a pivotal moment for spiritual merit, linking the physical act of visiting Imam Husayn’s shrine with the ultimate reward of Paradise. This narration underscores the Shia theological emphasis on *Ziyarat* not merely as remembrance, but as a means of securing divine favor and intercession through the Ahl al-Bayt.

en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 2. Abū ‘Ali Muḥammad ibn Hammām narrated to me from Ja’far ibn Muḥammad ibn Mālik Al-Fazāri, from Aḥmad ibn ‘Ali ibn ‘Ubayd Al-Ju’fi, from Ḥusain ibn Sulaymān, from Ḥusain ibn Asad, from Ḥammād ibn ‘Isā, from Ḥarīz, who said: Abū ‘Abdillāh (Imam Sādiq (a.s.)) said:
(Entering) Paradise is made mandatory for those who go to the Ziyārah of Ḥusain (a.s.) on the Day of ‘Āshūrā.
